segments.text: Thank you for helping with the museum family day.
The briefing will start in the education room, not the front hall.
Blue badge volunteers will guide visitors to the new science gallery.
Green badge volunteers should prepare activity tables near the cafe.
Meet your team leader at eight forty-five so the doors can open at nine.
